sites.name: The House of Cong Tu Bac Lieu
sites.event: Associated with the anecdotes of Ba Huy (the Bac Lieu Dandy) - a wealthy and notoriously flamboyant figure in the former Six Provinces of Southern Vietnam.

sites.name: Memorial Site for Southern Vietnamese Don Ca Tai Tu Art and Composer Cao Van Lau
sites.event: The resting place of the late composer Cao Van Lau, author of the immortal song 'Da co hoai lang', the predecessor of today's vong co.

sites.name: Bac Lieu Bird Sanctuary
sites.event: A nature reserve with a mangrove forest ecosystem and home to thousands of wild birds.

sites.name: Tac Say Church (Father Diep)
sites.event: Associated with the touching story of Father Truong Buu Diep's life, it is the largest Catholic pilgrimage site in the Mekong Delta.

sites.name: Xiem Can Pagoda
sites.event: One of the largest and most splendid Khmer pagodas in Southern Vietnam, representing the architecture and spiritual culture of the Khmer people.

sites.name: Quan Am Phat Dai Area (Mother Nam Hai)
sites.event: A famous spiritual and cultural site featuring an 11-meter-tall statue of Lady Buddha Nam Hai facing the East Sea.

sites.name: Vinh Hung Ancient Tower
sites.event: A special national artistic and architectural relic, the only remaining trace of Oc Eo culture in Southwestern Vietnam.

sites.name: Bac Lieu Ancient Longan Garden
sites.event: A century-old longan garden associated with the history of migration and land reclamation by the people of the Giong Nhan area.

place.commune: Hiep Thanh Commune, Vinh Trach Dong Commune

sites.name: Bac Lieu Salt Fields
sites.event: The production site of the famous 'Bac Lieu Salt' brand; salt-making here has been recognized as a National Intangible Cultural Heritage.

place.district: Hoa Binh District, Dong Hai District

sites.name: Temple of President Ho Chi Minh
sites.event: Secretly built and protected by the people of Chau Thoi Commune right in the heart of enemy territory throughout the fierce war years.
